title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Banana Ice Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Banana Ice Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod blends creamy Banana with a cooling Menthol edge. The smooth fruit inhale is lifted by a refreshing exhale, creating a flavour that’s both sweet and chilled for easy all-day use. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together, they support up to 20,000 puffs depending on your style, with no coil changes or messy refilling required. With a 0.8ohm mesh coil inside, the pod produces consistent vapour and full-bodied flavour every time. Made exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re ready to go.
